## Personality

Thomas Lynde is described as a meek little man. Among the people of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he is known simply as "[Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) Lynde's husband."

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)_

## History

Thomas Lynde is the husband of Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who keeps a watchful eye on their neighbors in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). When his wife notices [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) driving out of town in his finest clothes, she investigates and discovers that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and his sister [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) plan to adopt an orphan boy to help on their farm.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025)_

## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas Lynde is married to [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) as her husband. The two live together in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) manages household affairs and observes the goings-on of their neighbors.
